about: Immutable pre-release single-file designs. Each must produce the documented source re-import diagnostic. Current and forward-compatible native projects are indexed in ../format-2/projects.json.

projects.origin: Synthetic legacy-compatible optional fields on two schematic sheets. Covers directed and default off-sheet connectors, an unbounded sheet with a title block, named frames on infinite and fixed sheets, an ordinary text frame and PDF output layouts.

Synthetic future minor with an unknown connector direction, text-frame role, output layout, nested settings and an unknown object between two readable items. An unrelated edit must preserve them in place.
Synthetic two-channel schematic after extracting a frame. A generated label retains the original hyphen pin-name style, stable part ID and pin number.
Synthetic two-channel schematic after extracting a frame. A generated label retains the original underscore pin-name style, stable part ID and pin number.
Synthetic next-minor generated name with an unfamiliar style and nested properties. Its literal fallback preserves channel connectivity.

The sample project with format 1.3 fields (board rule sets with a disabled set, a Z-Axis Clearance rule over pours, a via fence along poured copper edges, related components), saved by the 1.3 build; synthesised. Restamped 1.4 (1.4 is the first supported format; pre-release formats are not supported).
Synthetic future minor version: unknown top-level, document and item fields, unknown item, document and symbol-shape kinds. Must open and save back unchanged.
Synthetic future major version that declares compatibleWith 1.1 and holds nothing unknown: read-only, Save As writes a lossless 1.1 copy.
Synthetic future major version with an object kind this build doesn't know: read-only, no copy offered.
Synthetic future major version with a structure this build can't read: refused with the 'newer Atrium' message.

Generic parts (format 1.3): shared regenerable definitions (def.generic) for resistors (IEC and ANSI), capacitors, an electrolytic, an LED, a Schottky diode, a crystal and a 2×5 header on two sheets, per-part values and ratings, and a dynamic connector split into two parts, as the 1.3 build saves them; synthesised. Restamped 1.4 (1.4 is the first supported format; pre-release formats are not supported).

Three synthetic definitions in one explicit component family, two package variants of the same chip with different terminal designators and a placed variant with a visible manufacturer part number. Restamped 1.4 (1.4 is the first supported format; pre-release formats are not supported).

Saved import of a synthetic binary SchDoc with a rotated component, multipart designator, a custom pin font, a port with its electrical endpoint on the right, and connector-owned cross-reference captions. Restamped 1.4 (1.4 is the first supported format; pre-release formats are not supported).

Synthetic future minor version (written by the 1.3 build for the 0.5.0 preview): the sample with an unknown rule type, a known-type rule this build can't validate (unknown scope kind), unknown settings on a rule, on the rules object and on rule sets, an unknown project-level rule type, an unknown item kind (bondwire) and item field, and a drawing with an unknown view type, unknown view/option/sheet/drawing/note fields, an unknown dimension type, a dimension with an unknown anchor kind and a callout with an unknown anchor kind. Must open, edit and save back with every unknown subtree unchanged.

Synthetic future minor version (written by the 1.3 build for the 0.5.0 preview): the sample with values a newer minor version may add to known fields (a power style and direction, a port I/O type, an image type, a sheet size, orientation and title block, a PCB text font, justification and stroke font, a panel separation, a revision status, a multichannel naming scheme), fields on panel sub-objects, cells, BOM views, symbols and pins (and a new pin electrical type), a board shape with a new segment kind, a layer stack with a new layer type, a layout block of a newer version, and a generic part from a newer generator. Must open, edit and save back with every unknown value unchanged.

Format 1.4 signals and tags (app/signals.js), saved by the 1.4 build; synthesised from the sample: an AC-coupled differential signal spanning two series capacitors with stored stage names, a single-ended signal spanning a series resistor with a stored path, a bus, signal-, net- and path-level tags, a series override, naming conventions and a declined suggestion; the legacy mirror (board rules net classes, pairs, pair classes and lengthTuning xSignals) as written.
Synthetic future minor version (written by the 1.4 build): v1.4-signals with unknown fields on the signals store, a signal, a leg and a tag. Must open and save back unchanged.
Synthetic future minor version (written by the 1.4 build): v1.4-signals with a version 2 signals store, which this build sets aside whole (the board reads its legacy mirror) and restores on save.

Two 0603 resistor definitions with the same embedded STEP model inline in footprint.model3d.stepText, as format 1.3 builds save them (one with library provenance), placed on a sheet and a board; synthesised. Opens and saves unchanged: inline models are never moved into project.blobs on open.
The same project in format 1.4: the STEP model stored once in project.blobs keyed by its SHA-256 and referenced by footprint.model3d.sha256, and libraryRef with rev and per-side hashes; synthesised.

Format 1.4 project rules (app/project-rules.js), saved by the 1.4 build; synthesised from the sample with a second board: the rule book in project.designRules (rules shared by both boards, a width rule for the second board only with a severity and an origin, ERC levels and a matrix cell as schematic rules, a scoped ERC rule), and the mirrors (each board's doc.rules, project.erc) as written.
Synthetic future minor version (written by the 1.4 build): v1.4-project-rules with a version 4 rule book, which this build sets aside whole (the boards read their mirrors) and restores on save.
